workstreams.title: Establish provider behavior
workstreams.intent: Implement the backend contract and its observable behavior.
workstreams.completion_signal: The provider contract passes its focused validation.

workstreams.title: Integrate the consumer
workstreams.intent: Consume the stable backend contract from the frontend.
workstreams.completion_signal: The frontend behavior passes focused validation.

workstreams.title: Validate the complete flow
workstreams.intent: Verify the provider and consumer work together.
workstreams.completion_signal: The declared cross-aspect integration check passes.

tasks.title: Establish provider contract
tasks.intent: Define the stable contract consumed by the frontend.
tasks.dod: The provider contract is explicit and its validation passes.

validation.expected: The contract is valid and stable for consumers.

tasks.title: Implement provider behavior
tasks.intent: Implement the configured feature behavior behind the stable contract.

validation.procedure: Run the project-defined provider behavior check.
validation.expected: The provider implements the configured behavior.

tasks.title: Consume provider contract
tasks.intent: Render the configured feature behavior through the frontend.
tasks.dod: Frontend behavior passes its focused consumer validation.

validation.procedure: Run the project-defined frontend consumer check.
validation.expected: The frontend consumes the declared provider contract.

tasks.title: Validate integrated feature flow
tasks.intent: Verify the frontend and backend complete the feature flow together.
tasks.dod: The declared feature round-trip check passes.

validation.procedure: Run the project-defined integrated feature check.
validation.expected: The UI and backend complete the configured feature round trip.
